records.description: Select an entry to edit or create a new one. Save to apply; removals also remain pending.
records.conflict: Changed in another panel. Your draft is kept; discard and reload to avoid overwriting other entries.

records.publishFailed: The full publication was not confirmed. Check the channel, permissions and emojis before retrying.
records.publicationUncertain: Creation was not confirmed. Check Discord and select the message or channel that was created before publishing again.
